activity_summary: At the reckoning you looked at the boxes broken open on the parlour table. Heminges's hands were sorting pennies and halfpence. Edith's folded account lay under the candlestick. Late snow was at the window. You were not in the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: attendee in The boxes and the snow

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Sorted pennies and halfpence by size, and is only hands in the frame.

entities.name: Edith Kettlewood
entities.context: Is not in the room. Her folded account lies under the candlestick.

facets.activity: Looked at the coins and Edith's paper
